name: Per-pixel 3D-DDA Renderer
definition: A CPU-based rendering method that performs a 3D Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) per pixel over a brickmap, serving as a clean-room alternative to column-coherent raycasting.
summary: The Per-pixel 3D-DDA Renderer is a CPU-based volume rendering method that traverses brickmaps per pixel to enable correct transparent voxel compositing without depth sorting.
